instruction:
Task: Click a 'Pencil Mode' toggle button, then select a grid cell, then click number buttons (1-9) to add or remove candidate numbers (pencil marks) in that cell.
Expected Result: Small 'pencil mark' versions of the selected numbers appear or disappear as candidates within the chosen cell. Inputting a main number might be disabled or visually distinct while in pencil mode.

Note: The task is only considered successful if the expected result is achieved; otherwise, it is deemed infeasible.
